models.name: linkedin_ads__account_report
models.description: Each record in this table represents the daily performance of ads at the account level. Use the latest version of both the account and the campaign to ensure the most up-to-date data.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The day of the activity.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Unique internal ID representing the account.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: A label for the account.

columns.name: version_tag
columns.description: An integer representation of the version of the account.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the account, such as 'USD' for United States Dollar (default).

columns.name: last_modified_at
columns.description: The timestamp of when the version was updated.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: The timestamp of when the account was created.

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: The count of chargeable clicks.

columns.name: impressions
columns.description: This is the count of "impressions" for Direct Ads and Sponsored Updates and "sends" for InMails.

columns.name: cost
columns.description: The cost of the ads in the local currency.

columns.name: conversion_value_in_local_currency
columns.description: The value generated by your conversions, displayed in your LinkedIn account's local currency, on the given day. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.
